tags: environment-agent-trajectory-data; web-agent; information-seeking; synthetic-data; reconstructed-trajectories; rejection-sampling; agentic-rl; mixed-verifier; llm-as-judge; partial-release; version-drift
one_line_summary: WebSailor trains web-search agents with just over 2,000 successful reconstructed ReAct trajectories and DUPO's mixed format/answer reward, but officially releases only 20 QA examples—not the complete successful or failed trajectories.
one_line_summary_zh: WebSailor 用 2,000 余条成功的重构 ReAct 轨迹和 DUPO 的混合格式/答案奖励训练网页搜索 agent，但官方目前只发布了 20 条 QA 示例，并未发布完整成功或失败轨迹。

title: WEBSERV: A Full-Stack and RL-Ready Web Environment for Training Web Agents at Scale
venue: arXiv preprint (expanded v2); earlier version presented at MTI-LLM @ NeurIPS 2025
authors: Yuxuan Lu; Ziyi Wang; Jing Huang; Hui Liu; Jiri Gesi; Yan Han; Shihan Fu; Tianqi Zheng; Xianfeng Tang; Chen Luo; Yisi Sang; Jin Lai; Dakuo Wang
source_role: agent_environment; infrastructure; data_release; construction_recipe; verifier_reward; scaling_study
construction_layer: prompt_sourcing; trace_writing; search_substrate; reward_verifier_layer; optimizer_scaffold; scaling_report; release_audit
domains: web_agents; agent_trajectories; browser_interaction; environment_interaction; reinforcement_learning; ecommerce; content_management; software_development
tags: environment-agent-trajectory-data; web-agent; browser-interaction; webarena-lite; incus; container-isolation; resettable-environment; sft-trajectories; on-policy-rl; grpo; environmental-verifier; release-gap
one_line_summary: WebServ releases 726 success-filtered Claude browser traces and the code for resettable Incus-backed GRPO training, but not failed traces, record-level outcomes, Qwen RL rollouts, checkpoints, or a pinned environment bundle.
one_line_summary_zh: WebServ 公开了 726 条经成功筛选的 Claude 浏览器轨迹及 Incus 隔离式 GRPO 训练代码，但未公开失败轨迹、逐条结果标签、Qwen 在线 RL rollout、模型检查点或可固定复现的环境镜像。

title: When Data is the Algorithm: A Systematic Study and Curation of Preference Optimization Datasets
authors: Aladin Djuhera; Farhan Ahmed; Swanand Ravindra Kadhe; Syed Zawad; Heiko Ludwig; Holger Boche
one_line_summary: When Data is the Algorithm: A Systematic Study and Curation of Preference Optimization Datasets addresses curation and systematic study of preference-optimization data.
one_line_summary_zh: 该工作分析开放 DPO 语料，并利用逐样本任务、输入质量和奖励标注构建 UltraMix。

title: When To Solve, When To Verify: Compute-Optimal Problem Solving and Generative Verification for LLM Reasoning
authors: Nishad Singhi; Hritik Bansal; Arian Hosseini; Aditya Grover; Kai-Wei Chang; Marcus Rohrbach; Anna Rohrbach
one_line_summary: The paper shows when solution sampling beats generative verification and fits scaling laws for allocating compute between them.
one_line_summary_zh: 论文说明何时应扩大解答采样、何时应扩大生成式验证，并拟合二者的计算分配标度律。

title: Where LLM Agents Fail and How They can Learn From Failures
authors: Kunlun Zhu; Zijia Liu; Bingxuan Li; Muxin Tian; Yingxuan Yang; Jiaxun Zhang; Pengrui Han; Qipeng Xie; Fuyang Cui; Weijia Zhang; Xiaoteng Ma; Xiaodong Yu; Gowtham Ramesh; Jialian Wu; Zicheng Liu; Pan Lu; James Zou; Jiaxuan You
one_line_summary: AgentErrorBench releases 200 annotated failed ALFWorld, WebShop, and GAIA episodes with a 17-type taxonomy, minimal root causes, and feedback, while annotation agreement and replay metadata remain material audit limits.
one_line_summary_zh: AgentErrorBench 发布 200 条带标注的 ALFWorld、WebShop 与 GAIA 失败轨迹，含 17 类错误分类、最小根因与纠正反馈；标注一致性与回放元数据仍是主要审计缺口。

title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?
authors: Mert Cemri; Melissa Z. Pan; Shuyi Yang; Lakshya A. Agrawal; Bhavya Chopra; Rishabh Tiwari; Kurt Keutzer; Aditya Parameswaran; Dan Klein; Kannan Ramchandran; Matei Zaharia; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Ion Stoica
one_line_summary: MAST-Data scales a human-derived 14-mode failure taxonomy to more than 1,600 multi-agent execution traces for structured diagnosis and judge evaluation.
one_line_summary_zh: MAST-Data 将人工归纳的 14 类多智能体失效分类扩展到逾 1,600 条执行轨迹，支持协作过程诊断与 judge 评测。

title: Wider or Deeper? Scaling LLM Inference-Time Compute with Adaptive Branching Tree Search
authors: Yuichi Inoue; Kou Misaki; Yuki Imajuku; So Kuroki; Taishi Nakamura; Takuya Akiba
tags: ab-mcts; adaptive-branching; monte-carlo-tree-search; response-revision-trees; external-feedback; test-time-compute; treequest; coding
one_line_summary: AB-MCTS allocates a fixed inference budget between fresh response branches and feedback-conditioned revisions, producing scored answer trees that released code can persist even though the paper's realized trees are not public.
one_line_summary_zh: AB-MCTS 在固定推理预算下，自适应选择生成新回答分支或沿既有回答进行反馈驱动修订，形成带外部评分的响应—修订树；公开代码可保存完整本地树和逐调用日志，但论文实验的原始树、全部回答、未选分支与 API 日志并未发布。

title: WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild
authors: Bill Yuchen Lin; Yuntian Deng; Khyathi Chandu; Faeze Brahman; Abhilasha Ravichander; Valentina Pyatkin; Nouha Dziri; Ronan Le Bras; Yejin Choi
one_line_summary: WildBench curates hard real-user tasks and applies task-specific checklists for automatic, interpretable model comparison.
one_line_summary_zh: WildBench 从真实用户对话筛选高难任务，并用任务专属核对表进行自动、可解释的模型比较。

title: WOMD-Reasoning: A Large-Scale Dataset for Interaction Reasoning in Driving
authors: Yiheng Li; Cunxin Fan; Chongjian Ge; Seth Z. Zhao; Chenran Li; Chenfeng Xu; Huaxiu Yao; Masayoshi Tomizuka; Bolei Zhou; Chen Tang; Mingyu Ding; Wei Zhan
tags: womd; waymo; driving; interaction-reasoning; intention-reasoning; synthetic-qa
one_line_summary: WOMD-Reasoning converts 63,000 WOMD scenes into 2.94 million GPT-4 Turbo Q&As, including 409,000 interaction and intention records that may depend on future trajectories.
one_line_summary_zh: WOMD-Reasoning 将 6.3 万个 Waymo 运动场景转成 294 万条规则支撑与 LLM 撰写的问答，但生成式交互叙述和未来感知标签必须分别进行因果与质量审计。

title: xVerify: Efficient Answer Verifier for Reasoning Model Evaluations
authors: Ding Chen; Qingchen Yu; Pengyuan Wang; Wentao Zhang; Bo Tang; Feiyu Xiong; Xinchi Li; Minchuan Yang; Zhiyu Li
one_line_summary: xVerify trains lightweight answer-equivalence verifiers on VAR, a roughly 56K-record collection of long reasoning answers with correctness labels.
one_line_summary_zh: 约5.6万问答验证样本以参考答案给出对错标签，适用于训练轻量验证器与推理结果评测。

title: YESciEval: Robust LLM-as-a-Judge for Scientific Question Answering
authors: Jennifer D’Souza; Hamed Babaei Giglou; Quentin Münch
one_line_summary: A rubric-based evaluation framework for scientific question answering that audits judge robustness under adversarial data.
one_line_summary_zh: 以 9 项 rubric、对抗变体和开源 judge 审计科学问答回答的可靠性。

title: Z1: Efficient Test-time Scaling with Code
authors: Zhaojian Yu; Yinghao Wu; Yilun Zhao; Arman Cohan; Xiao-Ping Zhang
tags: z1; code-reasoning; long-short-trajectories; teacher-distillation; shifted-thinking-window; test-time-compute; reasoning-efficiency; sft
one_line_summary: Z1 releases 107,173 Code Evol-Instruct-derived prompts with QwQ-32B-Preview response trajectories and pairs their SFT use with a token-capped Shifted Thinking Window for efficient inference.
one_line_summary_zh: Z1 发布 107,173 条 Code Evol-Instruct 派生问题与 QwQ-32B-Preview 完整响应轨迹，并用 Shifted Thinking Window 约束推理预算；但数据没有正确性 verifier、长短标签、许可证或去污染记录。

title: Zebra-CoT: A Dataset for Interleaved Vision-Language Reasoning
authors: Ang Li; Charles Wang; Deqing Fu; Kaiyu Yue; Zikui Cai; Wang Bill Zhu; Ollie Liu; Peng Guo; Willie Neiswanger; Furong Huang; Tom Goldstein; Micah Goldblum
domains: geometry, physics, algorithms, 2D and 3D reasoning, embodied planning, logic, games, and visual search
one_line_summary: Zebra-CoT serializes both textual thoughts and intermediate images so a model can learn to generate visual aids during multi-step reasoning.
one_line_summary_zh: Zebra-CoT 把文字思考与中间图像交错保存为 18.2 万条视觉推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域。

title: Zero-Overhead Introspection for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
authors: Rohin Manvi; Joey Hong; Tim Seyde; Maxime Labonne; Mathias Lechner; Sergey Levine
one_line_summary: ZIP-RC reuses reserved logits to predict reward and remaining length without an extra inference pass, then allocates prefix-tree search by utility.
one_line_summary_zh: ZIP-RC 在同一次前向中预测奖励与剩余长度，并据此分配测试时搜索。

title: A Survey of Confidence Estimation and Calibration in Large Language Models
authors: Jiahui Geng; Fengyu Cai; Yuxia Wang; Heinz Koeppl; Preslav Nakov; Iryna Gurevych

one_line_summary_zh: 系统梳理大语言模型的置信度估计与校准：如何让自信程度更接近实际正确率。

title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models
venue: ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology
authors: Yupeng Chang; Xu Wang; Jindong Wang; Yuan Wu; Linyi Yang; Kaijie Zhu; Hao Chen; Xiaoyuan Yi; Cunxiang Wang; Yidong Wang; Wei Ye; Yue Zhang; Yi Chang; Philip S. Yu; Qiang Yang; Xing Xie
one_line_summary: A high-impact survey that turns “evaluate an LLM” into concrete choices about target, dataset, protocol, and metric.
one_line_summary_zh: 把大模型评测拆成评什么、在哪里评、怎样评的高影响力综述。

title: A Survey on Model Compression for Large Language Models
venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
authors: Xunyu Zhu; Jian Li; Yong Liu; Can Ma; Weiping Wang
tags: survey; compression; quantization; pruning; distillation; tacl-2024
one_line_summary: A TACL survey of quantization, pruning, and distillation for practical LLM deployment.
one_line_summary_zh: 综述量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏等压缩方法，以及相应的评测指标。

title: AGENT BANK: Towards Generalized LLM Agents via Fine-Tuning on 50000+ Interaction Trajectories
authors: Yifan Song; Weimin Xiong; Xiutian Zhao; Dawei Zhu; Wenhao Wu; Ke Wang; Cheng Li; Wei Peng; Sujian Li
domains: agent-reasoning; mathematics; programming; web; embodied-ai; tool-use
one_line_summary: AGENT BANK releases 51,287 paper-reported rationale-action-observation trajectories across 16 tasks for masked-loss trajectory tuning.
one_line_summary_zh: AGENT BANK 发布论文所报 51,287 条跨十六任务的理由、动作与观察轨迹，用于掩码式轨迹微调。

title: Agent-FLAN: Designing Data and Methods of Effective Agent Tuning for Large Language Models
authors: Zehui Chen; Kuikun Liu; Qiuchen Wang; Wenwei Zhang; Jiangning Liu; Dahua Lin; Kai Chen; Feng Zhao
domains: agent-reasoning; tool-use; web; embodied-ai; database; operating-systems
one_line_summary: Agent-FLAN releases 24,703 redesigned agent conversations that separate reasoning, retrieval, arguments, format following, and tool-use negatives for SFT.
one_line_summary_zh: Agent-FLAN 把代理轨迹改写为按能力配比的自然对话，并加入不应调用工具的负例，共公开 24,703 条 SFT 记录。

title: AGENTBANK: Towards Generalized LLM Agents via Fine-Tuning on 50000+ Interaction Trajectories
authors: Yifan Song; Weimin Xiong; Xiutian Zhao; Dawei Zhu; Wenhao Wu; Ke Wang; Cheng Li; Wei Peng; Sujian Li
one_line_summary: AGENTBANK releases 50K+ cross-task interaction trajectories with chain-of-thought rationale for every action.
one_line_summary_zh: AGENTBANK 汇集 16 项任务、五类智能体技能的五万余条交互轨迹，并为每个动作提供链式推理标注。

title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents
authors: Chang Ma; Junlei Zhang; Zhihao Zhu; Cheng Yang; Yujiu Yang; Yaohui Jin; Zhenzhong Lan; Lingpeng Kong; Junxian He
one_line_summary: AgentBoard contributes a tool-use or agent-environment surface with an explicit evaluation or verification contract.

title: MLLM-as-a-Judge: Assessing Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge with Vision-Language Benchmark
authors: Dongping Chen; Ruoxi Chen; Shilin Zhang; Yaochen Wang; Yinuo Liu; Huichi Zhou; Qihui Zhang; Yao Wan; Pan Zhou; Lichao Sun

authors: Yin Fang; Xiaozhuan Liang; Ningyu Zhang; Kangwei Liu; Rui Huang; Zhuo Chen; Xiaohui Fan; Huajun Chen

title: Navigate through Enigmatic Labyrinth A Survey of Chain of Thought Reasoning: Advances, Frontiers and Future
authors: Zheng Chu; Jingchang Chen; Qianglong Chen; Weijiang Yu; Tao He; Haotian Wang; Weihua Peng; Ming Liu; Bing Qin; Ting Liu
one_line_summary: An ACL 2024 survey that organizes chain-of-thought reasoning methods, current frontiers, and open questions.
one_line_summary_zh: 系统梳理思维链推理的方法、研究前沿、挑战与开放问题。

title: OffsetBias: Leveraging Debiased Data for Tuning Evaluators
authors: Junsoo Park; Seungyeon Jwa; Meiying Ren; Daeyoung Kim; Sanghyuk Choi
one_line_summary: OffsetBias releases instruction prompts, two candidate responses, and deliberately balanced evaluator labels for response comparison for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.

title: Omni-MATH: A Universal Olympiad Level Mathematic Benchmark for Large Language Models

one_line_summary_zh: OpenCodeInterpreter 公开 68K 条多轮代码对话和 192K 个 turn，把解释、执行反馈、模拟用户指导与修订组合成可用于 SFT 的静态记录。

title: OpenMathInstruct-1: A 1.8 Million Math Instruction Tuning Dataset
authors: Shubham Toshniwal; Ivan Moshkov; Sean Narenthiran; Daria Gitman; Fei Jia; Igor Gitman

one_line_summary_zh: MATH-500 是 verifier、PRM 和推理模型报告里常用的固定评测子集，用来降低整套 MATH 评测成本。

title: LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment
authors: Chunting Zhou; Pengfei Liu; Puxin Xu; Srini Iyer; Jiao Sun; Yuning Mao; Xuezhe Ma; Avia Efrat; Ping Yu; Lili Yu; Susan Zhang; Gargi Ghosh; Mike Lewis; Luke Zettlemoyer; Omer Levy
one_line_summary: LIMA uses 1,000 curated instruction-response pairs to test whether a capable base model needs data quality more than data volume to learn an assistant style.
one_line_summary_zh: LIMA 用 1,000 条精选指令—回答记录检验：能力较强的基础模型学习助手风格时，数据质量是否比数据规模更关键。

title: LongBench: A Bilingual, Multitask Benchmark for Long Context Understanding
authors: Yushi Bai; Xin Lv; Jiajie Zhang; Hongchang Lyu; Jiankai Tang; Zhidian Huang; Zhengxiao Du; Xiao Liu; Aohan Zeng; Lei Hou; Yuxiao Dong; Jie Tang; Juanzi Li
one_line_summary: LongBench exposes bilingual long-document QA, summarization, few-shot, and code tasks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary_zh: LongBench 把中英双语的长文档问答、摘要、少样本与代码任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts
authors: Pan Lu; Hritik Bansal; Tony Xia; Jiacheng Liu; Chunyuan Li; Hannaneh Hajishirzi; Hao Cheng; Kai-Wei Chang; Michel Galley; Jianfeng Gao
one_line_summary: MathVista exposes visual mathematical reasoning over diagrams, charts, and figures as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary_zh: MathVista 把基于示意图、图表与插图的视觉数学推理做成可审计的评测面。

title: MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
authors: Xiang Yue; Yuansheng Ni; Kai Zhang; Tianyu Zheng; Ruoqi Liu; Ge Zhang; Samuel Stevens; Dongfu Jiang; Weiming Ren; Yuxuan Sun; Cong Wei; Botao Yu; Ruibin Yuan; Renliang Sun; Ming Yin; Boyuan Zheng; Zhenzhu Yang; Yibo Liu; Wenhao Huang; Huan Sun; Yu Su; Wenhu Chen
one_line_summary: MMMU exposes college-level multimodal subject questions as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary_zh: MMMU 把大学水平的多模态学科题目做成可审计的评测面。

title: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment
authors: Andreas Köpf; Yannic Kilcher; Dimitri von Rütte; Sotiris Anagnostidis; Zhi-Rui Tam; Keith Stevens; Abdullah Barhoum; Nguyen Minh Duc; Oliver Stanley; Richárd Nagyfi; Shahul ES; Sameer Suri; David Glushkov; Arnav Dantuluri; Andrew Maguire; Christoph Schuhmann; Huu Nguyen; Alexander Mattick
one_line_summary: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment addresses open conversational alignment data.
one_line_summary_zh: OpenAssistant Conversations 构建并公开了 OASST1，包含约 16.1 万条消息、35 种语言、46.1 万个质量评分和一万余棵完整对话树，可用于指令微调、奖励模型训练和人类偏好对齐。

title: Orca 2: Teaching Small Language Models How to Reason
authors: Arindam Mitra; Luciano Del Corro; Shweti Mahajan; Andres Codas; Clarisse Simoes; Sahaj Agarwal; Xuxi Chen; Anastasia Razdaibiedina; Erik Jones; Kriti Aggarwal; Hamid Palangi; Guoqing Zheng; Corby Rosset; Hamed Khanpour; Ahmed Awadallah
one_line_summary: Orca 2 elicits task-specific reasoning strategies from GPT-4 and erases the strategy prompt during SFT so a smaller model learns both how and when to reason.
one_line_summary_zh: Orca 2 让 GPT-4 按任务生成不同策略的推理回答，并在 SFT 时擦除策略提示，使小模型同时学习怎样推理和何时采用哪种策略。

title: RAFT: Reward rAnked FineTuning for Generative Foundation Model Alignment
authors: Junxian He; Chunting Zhou; Xuezhe Ma; Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick; Graham Neubig
one_line_summary: RAFT samples candidates, selects the reward-best response, and fine-tunes the policy on it.
one_line_summary_zh: RAFT 从多个策略候选中保留奖励最高的回答，并用该回答迭代监督微调模型。

title: Reasoning with Language Model Prompting: A Survey
authors: Shuofei Qiao; Yixin Ou; Ningyu Zhang; Xiang Chen; Yunzhi Yao; Shumin Deng; Chuanqi Tan; Fei Huang; Huajun Chen
one_line_summary: An ACL 2023 survey of prompting methods used to elicit and study reasoning in language models.
one_line_summary_zh: 系统梳理如何用提示激发语言模型推理，并提供方法比较与学习资源。

title: RRHF: Rank Responses to Align Language Models with Human Feedback
authors: Zheng Yuan; Hongyi Yuan; Chuanqi Tan; Wei Wang; Songfang Huang; Fei Huang
one_line_summary: RRHF trains a policy to rank sampled responses in the same order as feedback, using a lightweight ranking loss.
one_line_summary_zh: RRHF 让模型对多来源候选回答的概率排序与反馈排序一致，无需 PPO 或单独奖励模型。

title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
authors: Yizhong Wang; Yeganeh Kordi; Swaroop Mishra; Alisa Liu; Noah A. Smith; Daniel Khashabi; Hannaneh Hajishirzi
one_line_summary: Self-Instruct repeatedly asks GPT-3 to invent, filter, and answer new tasks, expanding 175 human seeds into 82,439 synthetic SFT instances.
one_line_summary_zh: Self-Instruct 反复让 GPT-3 发明、过滤并回答新任务，把 175 条人写种子扩展为 82,439 条合成 SFT 实例。

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
authors: Carlos E. Jimenez; John Yang; Alexander Wettig; Shunyu Yao; Kexin Pei; Ofir Press; Karthik Narasimhan
one_line_summary: SWE-bench turns real GitHub issues into executable repository repair tasks.
one_line_summary_zh: SWE-bench 将真实 GitHub issue 转化为可执行仓库修复任务。

title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
authors: Yujia Qin; Shihao Liang; Yining Ye; Kunlun Zhu; Lan Yan; Yaxi Lu; Yankai Lin; Xin Cong; Xiangru Tang; Bill Qian; Sihan Zhao; Lauren Hong; Runchu Tian; Ruobing Xie; Jie Zhou; Mark Gerstein; Dahai Li; Zhiyuan Liu; Maosong Sun
one_line_summary: ToolLLM introduces ToolBench, a large tool-use dataset over 16,464 real-world APIs, plus ToolEval and ToolLLaMA for training and evaluating API-using models.
one_line_summary_zh: ToolLLM 提出 ToolBench：覆盖 16,464 个真实 API 的工具使用数据集，并配套 ToolEval 与 ToolLLaMA 用于训练和评测。

title: Towards Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Survey
authors: Jie Huang; Kevin Chen-Chuan Chang
one_line_summary: This survey separates supervised reasoning, inference-time elicitation, self-improvement, evaluation, and interpretation into distinct claim types.
one_line_summary_zh: 这篇综述把监督推理、推理时诱导、自改进、评测和解释拆成不同主张类型。

title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
venue: Published as ICLR 2024 in arXiv PDF; WebArena-x index also labels WebArena as NeurIPS 2024 Oral
authors: Shuyan Zhou; Frank F. Xu; Hao Zhu; Xuhui Zhou; Robert Lo; Abishek Sridhar; Xianyi Cheng; Tianyue Ou; Yonatan Bisk; Daniel Fried; Uri Alon; Graham Neubig
one_line_summary: WebArena exposes browser tasks on self-hosted realistic websites with functional checks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary_zh: WebArena 把自建真实网站上带功能性检查的浏览器任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
venue: Transactions on Machine Learning Research / arXiv
authors: Aarohi Srivastava; Abhinav Rastogi; Abhishek Rao; BIG-bench authors
one_line_summary: BIG-bench exposes collaborative suite of diverse language-model tasks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary_zh: BIG-bench 把社区协作构建的多样化语言模型任务集做成可审计的评测面。

title: DS-1000: A Natural and Reliable Benchmark for Data Science Code Generation
authors: Yuhang Lai; Chengxi Li; Yiming Wang; Tianyi Zhang; Ruiqi Zhong; Luke Zettlemoyer; Scott Wen-tau Yih; Daniel Fried; Sida Wang; Tao Yu
one_line_summary: DS-1000 exposes data-science code completion with executable tests and API constraints as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary_zh: DS-1000 把带可执行测试与 API 约束的数据科学代码补全做成可审计的评测面。

title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
venue: Transactions on Machine Learning Research / arXiv
authors: Percy Liang; Rishi Bommasani; Tony Lee; Dimitris Tsipras; Dilara Soylu; Michihiro Yasunaga; Yian Zhang; Deepak Narayanan; Yuhuai Wu; Ananya Kumar
one_line_summary: HELM 把语言模型评测组织成“场景 × 指标”的矩阵，不只看准确率，也看校准、鲁棒性、公平性、毒性、效率等维度。
one_line_summary_zh: HELM 把语言模型评测组织成“场景 × 指标”的矩阵，不只看准确率，也看校准、鲁棒性、公平性、毒性、效率等维度。

title: Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners
authors: Takeshi Kojima; Shixiang Shane Gu; Machel Reid; Yutaka Matsuo; Yusuke Iwasawa
one_line_summary: Zero-shot-CoT uses a generic cue and a second answer-extraction call to elicit test-time rationales without demonstrations.
one_line_summary_zh: Zero-shot-CoT 用通用提示和第二次答案抽取，在没有示例时诱导可见的测试时理由。

title: Pre-train, Prompt, and Predict: A Systematic Survey of Prompting Methods in Natural Language Processing
authors: Pengfei Liu; Weizhe Yuan; Jinlan Fu; Zhengbao Jiang; Hiroaki Hayashi; Graham Neubig
one_line_summary: A high-impact systematic survey of the prompt designs that later reasoning prompting builds on.
one_line_summary_zh: 系统整理提示构造、预训练模型与微调策略的高引综述。

title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
authors: Eric Zelikman; Yuhuai Wu; Jesse Mu; Noah D. Goodman
one_line_summary: STaR repeatedly turns answer-correct model rationales into new SFT data, bootstrapping reasoning from few demonstrations.
one_line_summary_zh: STaR 反复把答案正确的模型 rationale 转成新一轮 SFT 数据，用少量示范自举推理能力。

title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
authors: Yuntao Bai; Andy Jones; Kamalloo Eshghian; Anna Askell; Yudong Chen; Nova DasSarma; Dawn Drain; Stanislav Fort; Deep Ganguli; Tom Henighan; Nicholas Joseph; Sushma Kadavath; Jackson Kernion; Tom Conerly; Sheer El-Showk; Nelson Elhage; Zac Hatfield-Dodds; Danny Hernandez; Tristan Hume; Scott Johnston; Shauna Kravec; Liane Lovitt; Neel Nanda; Catherine Olsson; Dario Amodei; Tom Brown; Jack Clark; Sam McCandlish; Chris Olah; Ben Mann; Jared Kaplan
one_line_summary: HH-RLHF releases dialogue contexts, paired assistant responses, and helpfulness or harmlessness preferences including red-team interactions for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
one_line_summary_zh: HH-RLHF 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
authors: Mark Chen; Jerry Tworek; Heewoo Jun; Qiming Yuan; Henrique Ponde de Oliveira Pinto; Jared Kaplan; Harri Edwards; Yuri Burda; Nicholas Joseph; Greg Brockman; Alex Ray; Raul Puri; Gretchen Krueger; Michael Petrov; Heidy Khlaaf; Girish Sastry; Pamela Mishkin; Brooke Chan; Scott Gray; Nick Ryder; Mikhail Pavlov; Alethea Power; Lukasz Kaiser; Mohammad Bavarian; Clemens Winter; Philippe Tillet; Felipe Petroski Such; Dave Cummings; Matthias Plappert; Fotios Chantzis; Elizabeth Barnes; Ariel Herbert-Voss; William Hebgen Guss; Alex Nichol; Alex Paino; Nikolas Tezak; Jie Tang; Igor Babuschkin; Suchir Balaji; Shantanu Jain; William Saunders; Christopher Hesse; Andrew N. Carr; Jan Leike; Josh Achiam; Vedant Misra; Evan Morikawa; Alec Radford; Matthew Knight; Miles Brundage; Mira Murati; Katie Mayer; Peter Welinder; Bob McGrew; Dario Amodei; Sam McCandlish; Ilya Sutskever; Wojciech Zaremba
one_line_summary: HumanEval 用小而精的函数合成任务和单元测试定义代码生成能力，是代码 benchmark 的基础坐标。
one_line_summary_zh: HumanEval 用小而精的函数合成任务和单元测试定义代码生成能力，是代码 benchmark 的基础坐标。

title: Measuring Coding Challenge Competence With APPS
authors: Dan Hendrycks; Steven Basart; Saurav Kadavath; Mantas Mazeika; Akul Arora; Ethan Guo; Collin Burns; Samir Puranik; Horace He; Dawn Song; Jacob Steinhardt
one_line_summary: APPS 把代码评测推进到竞赛编程和复杂输入输出题，能暴露长程算法推理与实现能力。
one_line_summary_zh: APPS 把代码评测推进到竞赛编程和复杂输入输出题，能暴露长程算法推理与实现能力。

title: Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset
authors: Dan Hendrycks; Collin Burns; Saurav Kadavath; Akul Arora; Steven Basart; Eric Tang; Dawn Song; Jacob Steinhardt
one_line_summary: MATH 将竞赛级数学题系统化，覆盖代数、几何、数论、组合等方向，是硬数学评测的根节点之一。
one_line_summary_zh: MATH 将竞赛级数学题系统化，覆盖代数、几何、数论、组合等方向，是硬数学评测的根节点之一。

title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
authors: Karl Cobbe; Vineet Kosaraju; Mohammad Bavarian; Mark Chen; Heewoo Jun; Lukasz Kaiser; Matthias Plappert; Jerry Tworek; Jacob Hilton; Reiichiro Nakano; Christopher Hesse; John Schulman
one_line_summary: GSM8K provides 8,792 grade-school math word problems and uses final numeric answer checking while studying verifier models.
one_line_summary_zh: GSM8K 提供 8,792 道小学数学应用题，用最终数值答案检查，并研究 verifier models。

title: TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods
authors: Stephanie Lin; Jacob Hilton; Owain Evans
one_line_summary: TruthfulQA 检查模型是否复述常见误解和虚假信念，而不是给出真实回答。
one_line_summary_zh: TruthfulQA 检查模型是否复述常见误解和虚假信念，而不是给出真实回答。

title: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding
authors: Dan Hendrycks; Collin Burns; Steven Basart; Andy Zou; Mantas Mazeika; Dawn Song; Jacob Steinhardt
one_line_summary: MMLU 建立了覆盖 57 个学科的大规模多选题评测面，用来衡量模型在预训练知识、专业考试和跨学科推理上的基本能力。
one_line_summary_zh: MMLU 建立了覆盖 57 个学科的大规模多选题评测面，用来衡量模型在预训练知识、专业考试和跨学科推理上的基本能力。

title: What Disease Does This Patient Have? A Large-scale Open Domain Question Answering Dataset from Medical Exams
authors: Di Jin; Eileen Pan; Nassim Oufattole; Wei-Hung Weng; Hanyi Fang; Peter Szolovits
one_line_summary: MedQA-USMLE provides 12,723 English medical licensing-exam questions, with the full MedQA release spanning 61,097 multilingual questions.
one_line_summary_zh: MedQA-USMLE 常用英文子集有 12,723 道医学执照考试选择题；完整 MedQA 多语 release 约 61,097 题。

title: HellaSwag: Can a Machine Really Finish Your Sentence?
authors: Rowan Zellers; Ari Holtzman; Yonatan Bisk; Ali Farhadi; Yejin Choi
one_line_summary: HellaSwag tests grounded commonsense continuation by adversarially filtering easy artifacts from video-caption and activity data.
one_line_summary_zh: HellaSwag 用约 70K 个 adversarially filtered 续写选择题测试 grounded commonsense。

title: PubMedQA: A Dataset for Biomedical Research Question Answering
authors: Qiao Jin; Bhuwan Dhingra; Zhengping Liu; William W. Cohen; Xinghua Lu
one_line_summary: PubMedQA evaluates biomedical yes/no/maybe reasoning with 1,000 expert-labeled examples plus larger unlabeled and artificial subsets.
one_line_summary_zh: PubMedQA 用 PubMed 摘要评测生物医学 yes/no/maybe 推理，核心评测集是 1,000 个 expert-labeled PQA-L 样本。

title: WinoGrande: An Adversarial Winograd Schema Challenge at Scale
authors: Keisuke Sakaguchi; Ronan Le Bras; Chandra Bhagavatula; Yejin Choi
one_line_summary: WinoGrande scales Winograd-style commonsense pronoun resolution with adversarial filtering to reduce superficial cues.
one_line_summary_zh: WinoGrande 将 Winograd-style 常识消歧扩展到约 44K 题，并用 adversarial filtering 降低浅层线索。

title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification
authors: James Thorne; Andreas Vlachos; Christos Christodoulopoulos; Arpit Mittal
one_line_summary: FEVER links 185,445 factual claims to Wikipedia evidence and labels, making fact verification an evidence-grounded evaluation task.
one_line_summary_zh: FEVER 把 185,445 条 factual claims 绑定到 Wikipedia 证据句和三分类标签，是证据约束 fact verification 的经典 benchmark。

title: GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Natural Language Understanding
authors: Alex Wang; Amanpreet Singh; Julian Michael; Felix Hill; Omer Levy; Samuel R. Bowman
one_line_summary: GLUE is an ICLR 2019 multi-task NLU benchmark with nine English sentence and sentence-pair tasks plus a diagnostic set.
one_line_summary_zh: GLUE 是 ICLR 2019 的多任务 NLU benchmark，包含 9 个英文句子/句对任务和 diagnostic set。

title: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
authors: Zhilin Yang; Peng Qi; Saizheng Zhang; Yoshua Bengio; William W. Cohen; Ruslan Salakhutdinov; Christopher D. Manning
one_line_summary: HotpotQA makes multi-hop QA auditable by pairing answers with supporting Wikipedia facts.
one_line_summary_zh: HotpotQA 含约 113k 个 Wikipedia 多跳问答样本，并给出 supporting facts，使答案与证据链能一起被评测。

title: Spider: A Large-Scale Human-Labeled Dataset for Complex and Cross-Domain Semantic Parsing and Text-to-SQL Task
authors: Tao Yu; Rui Zhang; Kai Yang; Michihiro Yasunaga; Dongxu Wang; Zifan Li; James Ma; Irene Li; Qingning Yao; Shanelle Roman; Zilin Zhang; Dragomir Radev
one_line_summary: Spider made cross-domain text-to-SQL evaluation difficult by separating database schemas across train and test.
one_line_summary_zh: Spider 用 10,181 个问题、200 个数据库和跨 domain split 建立了经典 text-to-SQL 难题。
